			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_parthenon_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_parthenon }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bangkok_grand_palace_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_bangkok_grand_palace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_wat_arun }
		}
	}
	else = {
	change_building_level_in_location = {
		building = prev.building_type
		value = {
			add = prev.building_level
			multiply = -0.1
			floor = yes
		}
	}
}

			floor = yes
		}
	}

			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_beijing_imperial_granaries }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bursa_imperial_mint_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_bursa_imperial_mint }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_enderun_palace_school_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_enderun_palace_school }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_ayutthaya_foreign_quarters_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_ayutthaya_foreign_quarters }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_yunnan_weisuo_colonies_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_yunnan_weisuo_colonies }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_zhoushan_beacon_network_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_zhoushan_beacon_network }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_amber_room_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_amber_room }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_parthenon_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_parthenon }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_bangkok_grand_palace_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_bangkok_grand_palace }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { prev = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated building_level >= 2 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = { wonder = unique_wat_arun }
		}
	}
	else = {
	change_building_level_in_location = {
		building = prev.building_type
		value = {
			add = prev.building_level
			multiply = -0.33
			floor = yes
		}
	}
}
}
